semiconductor_relevance: High — SKY Technology Development Co., Ltd. specializes in vacuum technology and equipment manufacturing that is critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: SKY Technology Development Co., Ltd. focuses on the development and manufacturing of high-end industrial vacuum application equipment, including film deposition and crystalline growing equipment essential for semiconductor production. The company integrates R&D, manufacturing, sales, and services to support high technology and new material applications.
capabilities: Crystalline growing equipment for sapphire and SiC mono-crystals
E-beam evaporation and magnetic sputtering systems
CVD and PVD film deposition equipment
Dry vacuum pump systems and components

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and is affiliated with the Chinese Academy of Sciences, indicating a strong local presence in research and development.
